title: Aaja Veerna Mere Aakhri Nisa
body:
Aaja Veerna, Mere Akhri Nisa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kali Bhen Marna Jaavay, Meri Tanga Nu Mukha.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhiya Chon Bankay Athro, Teri Yaad Arahi Ay
Akbar Teri Judayi, Meray Dil Nu Khah Gayi Ay
Ek Vari Veer Aaja, Na Behn Nu Ruwa
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Jandiyan Akbar, Tu Khat Tay Naye-o-pauna
Naye Mukna Ay Vichora, Tu Veer Murr Naye Auna
Main Rona Vich Medinay, Tu Rona Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Piyo Day Bajh Jag Tay, Honday Veer Nay Sahara
Kitay Javay Veer Sughra, Naye Labda Koyi Chara
Keewein Jundiya Nay Behna, Marjaan Jay Bhira.
